scholarships.title: ETH Zurich Excellence & Swiss Government Scholarship
scholarships.benefitsFull: Covers full tuition fee waiver, a living and study stipend of CHF 12,000 per semester (ESOP) or monthly stipend of CHF 1,920 (Swiss Govt Excellence Scholarship), health insurance coverage, mentorship, and round-trip airfare.
eligibility: Outstanding academic performance in Bachelor's degree (top 10% of graduating class / CGPA above 8.5/10)
Direct admission offer or application submitted for an ETH Zurich Master's program
English language proficiency (IELTS 7.5+ or TOEFL iBT 100+)
Strong research interest demonstrated through a high-quality pre-proposal for the Master's thesis
docs: Official Academic Transcripts and Class Rank Certificate
Pre-proposal for Master's Thesis (1-2 pages)
Curriculum Vitae (CV) in Europass format
Two Letters of Recommendation from senior professors
Passport Copy and Proof of English Proficiency
steps: Check Master's program eligibility and prepare your preliminary research proposal.
Complete the online ETH Zurich Master's admission application portal.
Opt-in for the Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP) during application.
Upload required documents and submit the application before December 15 deadline.
scholarships.tip: Indian students must provide an official Rank Certificate proving top 5-10% standing in their university. Align your thesis pre-proposal directly with the ongoing research of an active ETH Zurich institute or professor.

scholarships.title: SINGA & ASEAN/NTU Science & Engineering Scholarship
scholarships.university: Nanyang Technological University & A*STAR Partner Universities
scholarships.benefitsFull: 100% tuition fee waiver, monthly living stipend up to SGD 3,200 for PhD (SINGA) or annual living allowance for UG (ASEAN/NTU), one-time airfare grant up to SGD 1,500, and a settling-in allowance of SGD 1,000.
eligibility: Open to international students with excellent academic records in Class 12 (for UG) or a Bachelor's/Master's degree (for PhD)
Strong passion for research in Science, Engineering, or Computing
Proficiency in written and spoken English
docs: Valid Passport
Official Academic Transcripts and Certificates
Statement of Purpose / Research Proposal
Two Academic Recommendation Letters
Proof of English Proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL if requested)
steps: Choose your desired research discipline or undergraduate degree program at NTU / A*STAR
Prepare academic transcripts, research proposal, and referee details
Submit your online application through the official SINGA or NTU admissions portal
Attend the online academic interview if shortlisted
scholarships.tip: For SINGA PhD applicants, reaching out to prospective supervisors at NTU or A*STAR labs beforehand to align your research interests drastically boosts selection chances.

scholarships.title: Australia Awards & Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
scholarships.university: University of Melbourne & Australian Partner Universities
scholarships.benefitsFull: 100% full tuition fee remission, establishment allowance, fortnightly living stipend, Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC), and round-trip economy airfare.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of an eligible partner country, including India.
Must hold an outstanding academic record (Class 12 standard cutoff 90%+ or high GPA for PG).
Must meet English language proficiency requirements (IELTS 6.5–7.0 overall).
Must fulfill Australian Student Visa (Subclass 500) criteria.
docs: Official Academic Transcripts & High School / Degree Marksheets
Valid Passport Copy
Proof of English Language Proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL)
Statement of Purpose (SOP)
Two Academic or Professional Letters of Recommendation
steps: Check course eligibility on the University of Melbourne or DFAT portal.
Apply for admission to an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate program.
Submit your scholarship application via the online OASIS or university portal.
Upload required academic transcripts, identity proof, and personal statements.
Attend the selection interview if shortlisted for Australia Awards.
scholarships.tip: For Australia Awards, clearly demonstrate how your chosen course will contribute to your home country's development goals, as development impact carries major weight in selection.

scholarships.title: Invest Your Talent in Italy & DSU Regional Need-Based Scholarship
scholarships.bestDate: Submit IYT by mid-February 2026 & DSU documents by July 2026
scholarships.benefitsShort: Full Tuition + Up to €8,158/yr Stipend + Internship
scholarships.benefitsFull: 100% tuition fee waiver, monthly grant of €1,000 (IYT) or up to €8,158 per year (DSU), free/discounted university accommodation, cafeteria meal vouchers, Italian language courses, and a guaranteed 3-month corporate internship.
eligibility: Open to international students including Indian citizens born on or after July 1, 1998 (for IYT)
For DSU: Low family income status with ISEE Parificato below €25,000 per year
Undergraduate or Bachelor's degree relevant to Engineering, IT, Management, Architecture, or Economics
Proof of English proficiency (Minimum IELTS 6.0, TOEFL 79, or University MOI Certificate)
docs: Valid Passport copy
Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates with Apostille/Legalization
ISEE Parificato (Family Income & Asset certification issued by an Italian CAF)
Updated CV in Europass format & Statement of Purpose
English Proficiency Certificate (IELTS/TOEFL/MOI)
steps: Apply for admission to an eligible degree program at a partner Italian university.
Submit the Invest Your Talent in Italy application via the official Esteri portal.
Prepare income & property documents in India, translate them into Italian, and get apostilled by MEA.
Apply for the DSU Regional Scholarship on the respective Italian region's portal (e.g., EDISU, DSU Toscana, ER.GO).
scholarships.tip: For Indian applicants, getting your family income documents translated to Italian and apostilled takes time. Prepare your ISEE Parificato documents early with a certified Italian CAF to guarantee your DSU stipend and free hostel.

scholarships.title: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship & Emile-Boutmy Scholarship
scholarships.benefitsFull: Comprehensive financial support including full or partial tuition fee waivers, a monthly living allowance (up to €1,181 for Master's and €1,700 for PhD), international return airfares, health insurance, and cultural activities.
eligibility: Must be a non-French citizen
Age limit: under 25 for Master's applicants and under 30 for PhD applicants (for Eiffel)
Admitted to a partner French university or institution
Academic excellence with a high GPA or top rank in previous degrees
docs: Curriculum Vitae (CV)
Statement of Purpose / Motivation Letter
Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
Proof of Language Proficiency (English or French)
Recommendation Letters
steps: Choose a participating French university and apply for your desired degree program
Contact the university's international relations office to express interest in the scholarship
Submit your scholarship application documents directly through the university before their internal deadline
Wait for the university to nominate your application to Campus France or the scholarship panel
scholarships.tip: Start communicating with your target French university months in advance. Since these scholarships require institutional nomination, securing the support of the university's admissions department is the most critical step for selection.

scholarships.title: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarship (GOI-IES)
scholarships.university: Eligible Higher Education Institutions in Ireland
scholarships.benefitsFull: Covers full tuition and registration fee waiver at the host Irish higher education institution, plus a €10,000 living stipend for one year of master's or PhD study.
eligibility: Must be a non-EU/EEA national
Must hold an offer (conditional or unconditional) from an eligible Irish Higher Education Institution
Demonstrated record of outstanding academic achievement
Strong rationale for pursuing studies in Ireland aligned with strategic career goals
docs: Valid Passport
Official Academic Transcripts and Degree Certificates
University Offer Letter (Conditional or Unconditional) from an Irish Institution
Two Academic / Professional Letters of Recommendation
Personal Statement addressing academic excellence and ambassadorial potential
steps: Apply to a master's or doctoral program at an eligible Irish university or institute.
Obtain a conditional or unconditional admission offer letter.
Create an account on the official Higher Education Authority (HEA) online application portal.
Complete the scholarship application form, upload mandatory documents, and submit before the deadline.
Shortlisted candidates undergo evaluation by an independent international assessment panel.
scholarships.tip: Apply for your university offer as early as December or January. Your scholarship essay must explicitly detail how your presence will foster educational and economic ties between India and Ireland.

scholarships.title: Manaaki New Zealand Government Scholarship
scholarships.university: Top Partner Universities in New Zealand
scholarships.benefitsFull: Covers 100% of tuition fees, a weekly living allowance of NZD 531, an establishment allowance of NZD 3,000, medical insurance, research funding for postgraduates, and round-trip economy flights.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of an eligible partner country and meet age requirements
Minimum of 1 year full-time or 2 years part-time relevant work experience
Must meet academic and English language entry requirements for chosen course
Agreement to return to home country for at least 2 years after completing studies
docs: Academic Transcripts & Graduation Certificates
Valid Passport
Proof of English Language Proficiency (IELTS / TOEFL)
Work Experience Certificates / Employer Endorsement
Development Impact Essay & Statement of Purpose
steps: Check country eligibility and key development priority sectors on the official NZ Scholarship website.
Prepare supporting documents including work experience proofs and certified academic records.
Register and submit the online application on the Manaaki NZ scholarship portal.
Shortlisted candidates undergo selection testing, interviews, and official university enrollment.
scholarships.tip: Align your chosen subject directly with your country's specific strategic priorities and clearly demonstrate in your essays how your studies will directly contribute to local socio-economic development upon your return.

scholarships.title: Swedish Institute (SI) Global Professionals Scholarship
scholarships.benefitsShort: Full Tuition + SEK 12,000/mo Stipend + Travel Grant
scholarships.benefitsFull: 100% full tuition fee coverage paid directly to the Swedish university, a monthly living stipend of SEK 12,000, a one-time travel grant of SEK 15,000, health and accident insurance, and membership in the SI Network for Future Global Leaders.
eligibility: Citizen of an SI eligible country (including India, Bangladesh, Indonesia, Kenya, Nigeria, Philippines, etc.)
Minimum 3,000 hours of demonstrated work experience (full-time, part-time, or leadership roles in civil society)
Must apply for an eligible Master's program via University Admissions Sweden by mid-January deadline
Demonstrated leadership experience from current or previous employment or civil society organizations
docs: Completed SI Curriculum Vitae (CV) on official template
Two official SI Letters of Reference (at least one from an employer)
Proof of Work and Leadership Experience on official SI template
Copy of Valid Passport
Master's application confirmation number from universityadmissions.se
steps: Apply for up to 4 eligible Master's programmes at Swedish universities via universityadmissions.se by mid-January.
Pay the university application fee and obtain your 8-digit application number.
Prepare all required application documents strictly using the official Swedish Institute templates.
Submit your scholarship application through the SI online portal during the application window in February.
scholarships.tip: Strictly calculate your 3,000 work hours and ensure your referees use the mandatory SI templates without changing any formatting, as unformatted submissions are instantly disqualified.

scholarships.title: NL Scholarship & TU Delft Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence
scholarships.benefitsFull: Covers full tuition fees for a TU Delft MSc programme and a living allowance contribution (€30,000 per year for non-EU/EEA students).
eligibility: International applicants with an outstanding academic record (CGPA 80%+ or equivalent bachelor degree from a reputable university)
Admitted to one of the 2-year regular MSc programmes at TU Delft
High English proficiency (IELTS minimum overall 7.0 or TOEFL iBT minimum 100)
docs: Complete MSc online application at TU Delft
Scholarship essay (answering specific prompt on thesis vision and impact)
Two reference letters from academic professors
Official undergraduate academic transcripts and degree certificate
English language test certificate (IELTS/TOEFL)
steps: Submit a complete application for a TU Delft MSc programme before 1 December.
Upload the required scholarship essay and two reference letters during the online application process.
Pay the application fee and complete admission submission.
Shortlisted candidates will be notified of the outcome by March/April.
scholarships.tip: Focus heavily on the scholarship essay: articulate a clear, innovative vision for your intended research/thesis and connect it directly to solving real-world global engineering or society challenges.

scholarships.title: Stipendium Hungaricum Government Scholarship
scholarships.benefitsShort: Full Tuition + Monthly Stipend + Accommodation Allowance + Health Insurance
scholarships.benefitsFull: 100% tuition-free education, monthly living stipend of HUF 43,700 (~€110) for Bachelor/Master level or HUF 140,000–180,000 (~€360–€460) for PhD students, free dormitory accommodation or housing allowance of HUF 40,000/month, and full health insurance coverage in Hungary.
eligibility: Citizen of an eligible Sending Partner country (including India)
Must be at least 18 years old by August 31 of the application year
Strong academic performance in preceding qualifications
Must meet specific program language and academic requirements set by chosen Hungarian university
docs: Online Application Form via DreamApply portal
Motivation Letter
Proof of English Language Proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL or MOI certificate)
Academic Transcripts and School/Degree Certificates
Medical Certificate of good health
Copy of Passport
steps: Register and complete the online application on the Stipendium Hungaricum DreamApply portal.
Select up to 2 study programs at partner Hungarian universities.
Submit required nomination paperwork to the designated Sending Partner Authority in your home country (e.g., Ministry of Education in India) if applicable.
Complete online entrance exams or oral interviews conducted by the selected Hungarian universities.
scholarships.tip: Prepare thoroughly for university-specific online interviews or technical entry exams, and ensure you submit your application to both the Tempus Public Foundation portal and any required home-country nominating agency.

scholarships.title: Khalifa University & NYU Abu Dhabi Full Financial Support
scholarships.benefitsShort: 100% Tuition Waiver + AED 4,000–8,000 Monthly Stipend + Housing & Flights
scholarships.benefitsFull: Complete financial aid covering 100% tuition fees, monthly living stipend ranging from AED 4,000 to AED 8,000 based on level of study, fully furnished university accommodation, health insurance coverage, annual return flight tickets, and research grant allowances.
eligibility: High academic record (minimum 85%+ in High School or GPA 3.5/4.0 in Undergraduate studies).
English language proficiency: IELTS minimum 6.5 or TOEFL iBT minimum 91.
Open to international students applying for full-time Undergraduate, Master's, or PhD programs.
Strong evidence of leadership, research potential, or outstanding extracurricular performance.
docs: Official Academic Transcripts and Graduation Certificates
Proof of English Proficiency (IELTS / TOEFL)
Statement of Purpose (SOP) or Personal Essay
2 to 3 Academic Recommendation Letters
Copy of Valid Passport and Updated Resume/CV
steps: Choose your eligible academic program at Khalifa University or NYU Abu Dhabi.
Submit an online admission application through the respective university portal.
Opt-in for full financial assistance/scholarship funding within the application form.
Upload all required academic transcripts, test scores, and supporting documents.
Complete the candidate selection interview if shortlisted by the admissions board.
scholarships.tip: Emphasize your STEM achievements, coding projects, or community involvement in your SOP; both NYUAD and Khalifa University value holistic candidate profiles alongside top academic scores.

scholarships.title: Taiwan ICDF & MOE Government Scholarship
scholarships.benefitsShort: Full Tuition + Monthly Stipend + Economy Flights
scholarships.benefitsFull: Covers 100% tuition fees, monthly living stipend ranging from NT$15,000 to NT$20,000 (~$500-$650 USD), student dormitory accommodation support, national health insurance, and round-trip economy class flights.
eligibility: Must be a citizen of an eligible target country (including India) with strong academic performance
Must hold a high school diploma for Bachelor's, a Bachelor's degree for Master's, or a Master's degree for PhD
Must meet English proficiency requirements (IELTS/TOEFL) or Chinese proficiency (TOCFL) based on instruction language
Must not hold ROC (Taiwan) citizenship or overseas Chinese student status
docs: Completed online application form
Attested copy of highest degree certificate and official academic transcripts
Proof of English proficiency (IELTS/TOEFL) or TOCFL certificate
Two reference letters from academic or professional supervisors
Comprehensive Study Plan or Statement of Purpose (SOP)
steps: Submit university admission application to the partner university in Taiwan
Fill out the scholarship online portal (ICDF) or MOE application form provided by local TECC
Submit physical application dossier to the Taipei Economic and Cultural Center (TECC) in your home country
Participate in the shortlisting interview conducted by TECC / ICDF committee members
scholarships.tip: Even if applying for English-medium degree programs, taking a basic TOCFL (Chinese Language) test or demonstrating basic Mandarin skills dramatically raises your interview score and selection probability at the TECC office.
